about: The public site's gameplay media from the site fifty (owner, 2026-10-11: "replace the old media with all my new ones", after every set is done). tools/media-r5/site-media.mjs builds public/media/site50-r14 from these picks: the round's deliveries (each take's 4K loop, stills and sound), the fifty frames and the films. Slots name a take id and, for stills, which still: moment (the key moment) or close (the close portrait).

home.shots: The home page's own shots (home r2, 2026-10-12; owner: "update all of these images to use new shots that are a lot better! and add far more mechanics ... and make a new section highlighting all game modes with custom shots for all of them"). Each slot of features, mechanics and modes is delivered as <sources.home>/<group>/<id>.png (shots/media-r5/home-r2/shot-list.json says what it must show and how it is staged); site-media.mjs builds it into home/<group>/<id>.webp and site-media-wire.mjs points the slot at it. Until then the slot shows its stand-in, a site fifty still. The Studio card's loop is delivered as features/studio.webm with the recorder's manifest as features/studio.json.

alt.en: The Garage in the Verdant Motor Pool: a KF51 Panther on the pedestal with its armor card, equipment loadout and the vehicle carousel

alt.en: X-ray kill cam on Verdant Fields by day: a T-72B3M's 3BM46 APFSDS round is traced into an X-rayed T-90M through the upper left hull side for 449 damage, with the struck modules labelled, the ballistic-analysis card and the Destroyed By card.

studio.label: Scene Studio on Frontier Basin at golden hour with the Director workspace open: a Type 10 rolls toward the lens as the T-90M it knocked out explodes and burns behind it, beside the sequence library, the Stage Sequence button and the site's takes as cards.

standIn.label: Scene Studio interface staging and replaying a Stridsvagn 122 attack on a Leclerc

alt.en: Armor flashlight on Verdant Fields by day: through a Leopard 2A7V's sight at x16, an angled T-90M Proryv 275 m away is painted green where the loaded APFSDS round penetrates and red where it does not, in front of a brick farmhouse.

alt.zh: 翠野原暂停的战斗上打开设置：声音选项卡中的乘员无线电选项已展开，列出各国乘员以及美国、英国、德国、俄罗斯、乌克兰、中国和法国乘员及其国旗。

alt.en: Final-kill replay on Frontier Basin at sunset: the replay camera looks down as an M1A2 SEPv3's APFSDS round strikes an M2A3 Bradley's turret cheek in a fireball, with the round's trace line, the Final Blow banner and the ballistic analysis card.
alt.zh: 日落时分的边疆盆地，最终击杀回放：回放镜头俯视 M1A2 SEPv3 的 APFSDS 弹命中 M2A3 Bradley 的炮塔侧面并爆出火球，画面中有弹道轨迹线、最终一击横幅和弹道分析卡片。

alt.en: The Service Record's medals: Chain of Thought, Zero-Shot and the rest of a commander's awards
alt.zh: 服役记录中的勋章：思维链、零样本以及指挥官获得的其他奖章

alt.en: The Tank Gallery's armor layer and dossier for the Challenger 3
alt.zh: 坦克画廊中 Challenger 3 的装甲图层与档案

alt.en: Scene Studio's Director with the site's filmed takes as presets, the T-90SM wedge assault loaded in the viewport
alt.zh: Scene Studio 的导演工作区：网站拍摄的镜头作为预设排列，视口中载入了 T-90SM 楔形突击

alt.en: Bots on Frontier Basin at sunset, seen from above: two bot tanks fight beside a farmhouse amid bursts of dust, a red tracer streaking in across the field, a green one beyond and a muzzle flash sparking at the right.
alt.zh: 日落时分的边疆盆地，俯瞰机器人对战：两辆机器人坦克在农舍旁的扬尘中交火，一道红色曳光弹横穿田野飞来，远处还有一道绿色曳光，右侧闪出炮口焰。

alt.en: Phone-landscape battle on Verdant Fields by day: a T-90M has just fired at a PT-91M Pendekar, the shot's smoke rising over its turret and the 6.4 s reload counting down by the sight, with the touch HUD (the movement stick, Fire, Scope and Auto Aim buttons, the consumables and the APFSDS selector).
alt.zh: 白天的翠野原，手机横屏战斗：一辆 T-90M 刚向 PT-91M Pendekar 开火，炮塔上方升起硝烟，瞄准镜旁 6.4 秒的装填倒计时正在进行，画面中是触控 HUD（移动摇杆、开火、瞄准镜与自动瞄准按钮、消耗品和 APFSDS 弹种选择）。

alt.en: A standard battle at Verdant Fields at sunset: a Leopard 2A7V fires from the tall grass, its penetration card on a ZTZ-99A2
alt.zh: 日落时分翠野原的标准战斗：一辆 Leopard 2A7V 在高草中开炮，穿深卡片显示对 ZTZ-99A2 的结果

alt.en: A T-90M races home with the enemy flag across Saltmere Bay
alt.zh: 一辆 T-90M 带着敌方旗帜穿过盐沼湾，全速驶回基地

alt.en: Tanks contest a capture zone at Frontier Basin as its ring turns amber
alt.zh: 坦克在边疆盆地争夺一处占领区，区域圆环转为琥珀色

alt.en: Turbo Ball at Verdant Fields: a BMPT Terminator 2 rams the ball between the goal's arcs as a T-90A leaps overhead
alt.zh: 翠野原的极速球：一辆 BMPT Terminator 2 在球门的弧框之间撞击足球，一辆 T-90A 从上方跃过

alt.en: Endless Horde at Cinder Junction at sunset: a Challenger 3's tracers converge on an M551A1 TTS of the third wave
alt.zh: 日落时分灰渣枢纽的无尽潮涌：Challenger 3 的曳光弹汇聚在第三波的一辆 M551A1 TTS 上

alt.en: Frontline Assault at Verdant Fields: a Leopard 2A7V climbs out of a trench past the wire toward the next sector
alt.zh: 翠野原的前线突击：一辆 Leopard 2A7V 越过铁丝网爬出堑壕，冲向下一段防区

alt.en: A T-14 Armata rocket-jumps over Olympus Basin under the galaxy sky in Gravity Mode
alt.zh: 重力模式中，一辆 T-14 Armata 在银河星空下火箭跳跃，飞越奥林匹斯盆地

alt.en: The Juggernaut, a shielded Merkava Mk 4 Barak, fights off the hunters in the Ironworks yard at night
alt.zh: 夜晚的钢铁厂货场，带护盾的重装首领 Merkava Mk 4 Barak 正在击退猎手

alt.en: Infected at Steinburg by night: an infected tank, glowing green, fires on the survivors
alt.zh: 夜晚斯泰因堡的感染模式：一辆发着绿光的感染者坦克向幸存者开火

alt.en: Realistic on Frosthollow by day: through a Stridsvagn 122's sights a Schützenpanzer Puma's ammunition erupts in a fireball between birch trunks, with the Realistic HUD's destroy-crew-or-ammo banner, a First Blood medal and the kill feed's ammo-rack kill.
alt.zh: 白天的霜谷，真实模式：透过 Stridsvagn 122 的瞄准镜，一辆 Schützenpanzer Puma 的弹药在白桦树干之间爆成火球，画面中有真实模式 HUD 的“击杀乘员或引爆弹药”横幅、第一滴血勋章，以及击杀信息栏中的弹药架殉爆击杀。

alt.en: Gun Game at Sunscar Oasis: a K2 Black Panther's round from the ladder's 152 mm howitzer bursts downrange
alt.zh: 日痕绿洲的武器进阶：K2 Black Panther 用阶梯中的 152 毫米榴弹炮开火，炮弹在远处炸开

alt.en: Drone mode at Nordhavn Fjord: the FPV drone's infrared view picks out enemy tanks among the pines as it dives
alt.zh: 诺德港峡湾的无人机模式：FPV 无人机俯冲时，红外视角在松林间映出敌方坦克

alt.en: AC-130 on Kestrel Airfield at night: the gunship's infrared view looks down on the convoy (an M6 Linebacker, an M1A2 Abrams SEPv2, a T-90M and a T-72 Ryś) by the extraction ring as a 152 mm HE round bursts among them, with the Splash card on a Leopard 2A5 and the 30 mm, 152 mm and guided-missile selector.
alt.zh: 夜晚的红隼机场，AC-130：炮艇机的红外视角俯视撤离圈旁的车队（一辆 M6 Linebacker、一辆 M1A2 艾布拉姆斯 SEPv2、一辆 T-90M 和一辆 T-72 Ryś），一发 152 毫米高爆弹在其中炸开，画面中有对 Leopard 2A5 的命中卡片，以及 30 毫米、152 毫米与制导导弹的武器选择。
